LanguageData.Wages.SettingsPanelChangeSettingsEffect: All settings will take effect after a few in-game minutes. A restart is not necessary.
LanguageData.Wages.TooltipWagesReceived: The wage that received every five days for
LanguageData.Wages.WageSliderLabel: Wages (paid every five days in silver)
LanguageData.Wages.ToolTipExempt: Check to make this pawn a owner. They will not demand wages. Hint: Disabled if this feature is only allowed in dev mode based on mod settings.
LanguageData.Wages.MainWindow_TotalWageTooltip: The projected cost if all non-exempt pawns if paid the wage selected below.
LanguageData.Wages.MainWindow_PayDayTooltip: When the pawns will next expect to be paid.
LanguageData.Wages.MainWindow_CreditTooltip: The amount your employees are already entitled to but have not managed to collect yet.
LanguageData.Wages.Settings_CurrencyTooltip: Select the item used to pay wages. Defaults to Silver.
LanguageData.Wages.Settings_ExemptChildrenTooltip: If checked, children and babies will not demand wages.
LanguageData.Wages.Settings_ExemptSlavesTooltip: If checked, colony slaves will not demand wages.
LanguageData.Wages.Settings_ExemptColonistsTooltip: If checked, regular free colonists will not demand wages.
LanguageData.Wages.Settings_MinWageTooltip: The smallest wage that can be paid to a pawn. This wage will result in the highest mood penalty, if it is below the Zero Mood Point.
LanguageData.Wages.Settings_MaxWageTooltip: The highest wage that can be paid to a pawn. This wage will result in the highest mood boost.
LanguageData.Wages.Settings_OwedBeforeGathering: Pawns start collecting wages at x owed
LanguageData.Wages.Settings_OwedBeforeGatheringToolti: Colonists will not collect wages immediately to avoid running for a single item. Only if they are owed more than this threshold will they start collecting.
LanguageData.Wages.Settings_OwedBeforeMoodlet: Pawns feel cheated starting at x owed
LanguageData.Wages.Settings_OwedBeforeMoodletTooltip: If colonists try to collect their wages and can't despite already being owed this amount they will feel cheated, applying a mood penalty until they are paid.
LanguageData.Wages.Settings_HideExemptTooltip: If checked, the option to exempt pawns from wages in the Wages tab will only be visible when RimWorld's Development Mode is active.
LanguageData.Wages.Settings_BreakChanceTooltip: The percentage chance, per in-game hour, that an unpaid pawn will suffer a Wage Theft mental break when owed more than the limit. Set to 0 to disable.
LanguageData.Wages.Settings_ZeroPointWageTooltip: The wage at which no mood boost or penalty is applied. Paying this wage will cause no mood effect. Going above will increase the mood. Going below will reduce the mood.
LanguageData.Wages.Alert_UnpaidWages_Explanation: The following pawns are owed significantly more wages than they have collected and will begin to suffer severe mood penalties or mental breaks:
